# although Gamma(z) has a pole at z = -1): M = 0.191313298, R = ceil2(1.56e-11) = 1.6e-11; E = 2.2374e-26.

# a ball whose radius holds the width (zeta on [-1/4, -1/8], end values more than 1 apart): NOT_DETERMINED.
